camera.shot_scale_bias: wide shots held far longer than the action requires

lens.dof: deep focus that keeps the far background legible

lighting.practicals: light is even and sourceless, as if the sky itself were the fixture

palette.grade: desaturated toward monochrome, with damp surfaces catching the only highlights

rules: figures small within a large landscape
water, mist and standing puddles in frame
composition.movement_of_subject: the subject walks slowly across the frame while the camera drifts at a different pace

sound.ambience_bias: dripping water, wind through grass, distant unidentifiable machinery

music.instrumentation: A single sustained organ note under sparse electronic tones
music.dynamics: barely changing across the whole passage

must_include: water is present as rain, mist, puddles or a running surface
the shot continues past the end of the action

notes: Long unhurried takes, damp landscapes, deep focus. The camera moves independently of the subject rather than following it.
